title: 鐵路隧道疏散步道
summary: 本課聚焦隧道步道連續性照明與協助疏散。從步道距離與協助時間建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把串行疏散時間帳與下車匯流區密度連成可驗證的介面，最後以受控演練證據安排整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
summaryEn: This course studies tunnel-walkway continuity lighting and assisted evacuation. Start with walkway distance and assistance time to define physical or information boundaries, connect serial accounting of egress time with density in alighting merge areas as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through evidence planning for controlled exercises. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 步道距離與協助時間與步道局部有效淨寬
stages.titleEn: Walkway distance and assistance time & Local effective walkway width
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「步道距離與協助時間」與「步道局部有效淨寬」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Walkway distance and assistance time" and "Local effective walkway width": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 步道距離與協助時間：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Walkway distance and assistance time: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「步道距離與協助時間」如何影響鐵路隧道疏散步道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Walkway distance and assistance time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Evacuation walkways in railway tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元把車門至安全出口分段記錄，將步行、跨越介面與等待協助分開而不使用單一最快步速。總旅行時間應同時計入移動與等待，不能只比較平面上的最短距離。坡道、門扇與轉乘決策都可能造成停頓；對行動受限旅客而言，較遠但連續可達的路徑往往比短而不連續的路徑更可用。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定步速與固定等待的概念估算，未含煙氣、擁擠及協助需求分布。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「步道距離與協助時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Segment the route from carriage door to safe exit, separating walking, interface crossing and assistance waits instead of using one fastest walking speed. Travel time includes movement and waiting rather than plan distance alone. Ramps, doors and transfer decisions can introduce pauses. For a mobility-limited traveller, a longer continuously accessible route can be more usable than a shorter route containing an inaccessible interruption. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant speed and fixed waiting; smoke, crowd interaction and distribution of assistance needs are omitted. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Walkway distance and assistance time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：行走距離 distance=120 m；假想步速 speed=0.8 m/s；等待時間 wait=35 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: walking distance distance=120 m; assumed walking speed speed=0.8 m/s; waiting time wait=35 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平面圖上最短的路徑一定是每位旅客最快的路徑」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The shortest route on a plan is always the fastest route for every passenger." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「步道距離與協助時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Walkway distance and assistance time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 步道距離與協助時間
knowledge.text: 本單元把車門至安全出口分段記錄，將步行、跨越介面與等待協助分開而不使用單一最快步速。總旅行時間應同時計入移動與等待，不能只比較平面上的最短距離。
knowledge.textEn: Segment the route from carriage door to safe exit, separating walking, interface crossing and assistance waits instead of using one fastest walking speed. Travel time includes movement and waiting rather than plan distance alone.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：平面圖上最短的路徑一定是每位旅客最快的路徑 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The shortest route on a plan is always the fastest route for every passenger. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「鐵路隧道疏散步道」的「步道距離與協助時間：機制與系統路徑」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出車輛、軌道、牽引供電、號誌與旅客的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「列車性能與時刻表室」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與版本一致的速度、時間、位置、負載及控制紀錄的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Walkway distance and assistance time: mechanism and system paths” in “Evacuation walkways in railway tunnels”. Draw the vehicle, track, traction, signaling and passenger interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Train performance and timetable room” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for version-aligned speed, time, position, load and control records, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「步道距離與協助時間」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Walkway distance and assistance time" is correct?
options: 平面圖上最短的路徑一定是每位旅客最快的路徑
本單元把車門至安全出口分段記錄，將步行、跨越介面與等待協助分開而不使用單一最快步速。
兩條走道接到同一狹窄出口時容量仍可直接相加
optionsEn: The shortest route on a plan is always the fastest route for every passenger.
Segment the route from carriage door to safe exit, separating walking, interface crossing and assistance waits instead of using one fastest walking speed.
Two corridors feeding one narrow exit always have directly additive capacity.
quiz.explanation: 本單元把車門至安全出口分段記錄，將步行、跨越介面與等待協助分開而不使用單一最快步速。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Segment the route from carriage door to safe exit, separating walking, interface crossing and assistance waits instead of using one fastest walking speed. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 步道距離與協助時間：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Walkway distance and assistance time: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「步道距離與協助時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Walkway distance and assistance time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：行走距離 distance=120 m；假想步速 speed=0.8 m/s；等待時間 wait=35 s。公式 y=distance/speed+wait，代入得 y=185 s。邊界：定步速與固定等待的概念估算，未含煙氣、擁擠及協助需求分布。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: walking distance distance=120 m; assumed walking speed speed=0.8 m/s; waiting time wait=35 s. Formula y=distance/speed+wait gives y=185 s. Boundary: Constant speed and fixed waiting; smoke, crowd interaction and distribution of assistance needs are omitted. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：分段記錄行走與等待，不以最快受試者代表所有旅客，並對照不同能力群體。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record movement and waiting separately, avoid representing everyone by the fastest participant, and compare groups with different abilities.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：行走距離 distance=120 m；假想步速 speed=0.8 m/s；等待時間 wait=35 s。公式 y=distance/speed+wait，代入得 y=185 s。邊界：定步速與固定等待的概念估算，未含煙氣、擁擠及協助需求分布。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: walking distance distance=120 m; assumed walking speed speed=0.8 m/s; waiting time wait=35 s. Formula y=distance/speed+wait gives y=185 s. Boundary: Constant speed and fixed waiting; smoke, crowd interaction and distribution of assistance needs are omitted.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「步道距離與協助時間」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Walkway distance and assistance time", which statement holds?
options: 算出疏散清空時間就足以單獨證明火災時絕對安全
只要安培小時數相同任何兩種電池續航就一定相同
原創假想教學輸入：行走距離 distance=120 m；假想步速 speed=0.8 m/s；等待時間 wait=35 s。
optionsEn: A calculated evacuation clearance time alone proves absolute fire safety.
Equal ampere-hour ratings guarantee equal runtime for any two batteries.
Original hypothetical teaching inputs: walking distance distance=120 m; assumed walking speed speed=0.8 m/s; waiting time wait=35 s.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：行走距離 distance=120 m；假想步速 speed=0.8 m/s；等待時間 wait=35 s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: walking distance distance=120 m; assumed walking speed speed=0.8 m/s; waiting time wait=35 s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 步道距離與協助時間：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Walkway distance and assistance time: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「步道距離與協助時間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Walkway distance and assistance time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 分段記錄行走與等待，不以最快受試者代表所有旅客，並對照不同能力群體。以「步道距離與協助時間」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record movement and waiting separately, avoid representing everyone by the fastest participant, and compare groups with different abilities. For walkway distance and assistance time, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把假想步速 speed 從 0.8 改成 0.88 m/s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 185 變為 171.364 s。先說明「步道距離與協助時間」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only assumed walking speed speed from 0.8 to 0.88 m/s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 185 to 171.364 s. Explain the causal direction for walkway distance and assistance time, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只量無人環境步行時間會低估轉乘負擔，電梯等待與路徑中斷可能主導總時間。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Uncrowded walking tests understate transfer burden when elevator waits or route interruptions dominate total time. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 分段記錄行走與等待，不以最快受試者代表所有旅客，並對照不同能力群體。以「步道距離與協助時間」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。
knowledge.textEn: Record movement and waiting separately, avoid representing everyone by the fastest participant, and compare groups with different abilities. For walkway distance and assistance time, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 只把假想步速 speed 從 0.8 改成 0.88 m/s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 185 變為 171.364 s。先說明「步道距離與協助時間」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Change only assumed walking speed speed from 0.8 to 0.88 m/s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 185 to 171.364 s. Explain the causal direction for walkway distance and assistance time, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「步道距離與協助時間」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Walkway distance and assistance time"?
options: 分段記錄行走與等待，不以最快受試者代表所有旅客，並對照不同能力群體。
量測時不必記錄溫度、速度、運行歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
出口每秒通過人數穩定就能證明站內沒有排隊
optionsEn: Record movement and waiting separately, avoid representing everyone by the fastest participant, and compare groups with different abilities.
Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Stable exit throughput proves that no queue is forming inside the station.
quiz.explanation: 分段記錄行走與等待，不以最快受試者代表所有旅客，並對照不同能力群體。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record movement and waiting separately, avoid representing everyone by the fastest participant, and compare groups with different abilities. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 步道距離與協助時間：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Walkway distance and assistance time: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「步道距離與協助時間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Walkway distance and assistance time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只量無人環境步行時間會低估轉乘負擔，電梯等待與路徑中斷可能主導總時間。回到「步道距離與協助時間」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Uncrowded walking tests understate transfer burden when elevator waits or route interruptions dominate total time. Trace the input chain for walkway distance and assistance time. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定步速與固定等待的概念估算，未含煙氣、擁擠及協助需求分布。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant speed and fixed waiting; smoke, crowd interaction and distribution of assistance needs are omitted.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平面圖上最短的路徑一定是每位旅客最快的路徑」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The shortest route on a plan is always the fastest route for every passenger." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只量無人環境步行時間會低估轉乘負擔，電梯等待與路徑中斷可能主導總時間。回到「步道距離與協助時間」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Uncrowded walking tests understate transfer burden when elevator waits or route interruptions dominate total time. Trace the input chain for walkway distance and assistance time. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

Uncrowded walking tests understate transfer burden when elevator waits or route interruptions dominate total time.
Two corridors feeding one narrow exit always have directly additive capacity.

steps.title: 步道局部有效淨寬：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Local effective walkway width: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「步道局部有效淨寬」如何影響鐵路隧道疏散步道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Local effective walkway width” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Evacuation walkways in railway tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元量測電纜箱、扶手與設備突出物造成的縮口，檢查上游寬步道是否仍受下游窄門控制。通道容量與有效淨寬有關，但扶手、門扇、行李及靠邊避讓會減少可用寬度。單位寬流率是情境參數，受方向、坡度與群體能力影響；多條通道的容量只有在下游沒有共同瓶頸時才能直接相加。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：均勻單向流的教學係數，不是法定疏散容量或規範值。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「步道局部有效淨寬」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Measure restrictions from cable boxes, handrails and protruding equipment, checking whether a wide upstream walkway remains limited by a narrow downstream door. Passage capacity depends on effective clear width, reduced by rails, door leaves, luggage and edge avoidance. Specific flow is scenario dependent and varies with direction, slope and user capability. Parallel passage capacities may be added only when they do not share a downstream bottleneck. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Teaching coefficient for uniform one-way flow, not a statutory evacuation capacity or code value. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Local effective walkway width” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：有效淨寬 width=2.4 m；假想單位寬流率 specific=1.1 persons/(m*s)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: effective clear width width=2.4 m; hypothetical specific flow specific=1.1 persons/(m*s).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩條走道接到同一狹窄出口時容量仍可直接相加」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Two corridors feeding one narrow exit always have directly additive capacity." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「步道局部有效淨寬」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Local effective walkway width”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Measure restrictions from cable boxes, handrails and protruding equipment, checking whether a wide upstream walkway remains limited by a narrow downstream door. Passage capacity depends on effective clear width, reduced by rails, door leaves, luggage and edge avoidance.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩條走道接到同一狹窄出口時容量仍可直接相加 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Two corridors feeding one narrow exit always have directly additive capacity. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「步道局部有效淨寬」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

只要坡道平均坡度適當就不用檢查平台與橫坡
本單元量測電纜箱、扶手與設備突出物造成的縮口，檢查上游寬步道是否仍受下游窄門控制。
optionsEn: Two corridors feeding one narrow exit always have directly additive capacity.
An acceptable mean ramp slope removes the need to check landings and cross-slope.
Measure restrictions from cable boxes, handrails and protruding equipment, checking whether a wide upstream walkway remains limited by a narrow downstream door.

steps.title: 步道局部有效淨寬：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Local effective walkway width: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「步道局部有效淨寬」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Local effective walkway width” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：有效淨寬 width=2.4 m；假想單位寬流率 specific=1.1 persons/(m*s)。公式 y=width*specific，代入得 y=2.64 persons/s。邊界：均勻單向流的教學係數，不是法定疏散容量或規範值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: effective clear width width=2.4 m; hypothetical specific flow specific=1.1 persons/(m*s). Formula y=width*specific gives y=2.64 persons/s. Boundary: Teaching coefficient for uniform one-way flow, not a statutory evacuation capacity or code value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測最窄位置的有效淨寬，將各方向流量分開統計，檢查下游是否出現排隊。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure clear width at the narrowest section, count each travel direction separately, and inspect downstream queues.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Boundary: Teaching coefficient for uniform one-way flow, not a statutory evacuation capacity or code value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: effective clear width width=2.4 m; hypothetical specific flow specific=1.1 persons/(m*s). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 步道局部有效淨寬：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Local effective walkway width: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「步道局部有效淨寬」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Local effective walkway width” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 量測最窄位置的有效淨寬，將各方向流量分開統計，檢查下游是否出現排隊。以「步道局部有效淨寬」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure clear width at the narrowest section, count each travel direction separately, and inspect downstream queues. For local effective walkway width, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把有效淨寬 width 從 2.4 改成 2.64 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 2.64 變為 2.904 persons/s。先說明「步道局部有效淨寬」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only effective clear width width from 2.4 to 2.64 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 2.64 to 2.904 persons/s. Explain the causal direction for local effective walkway width, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以建築軸線寬度代替淨寬會高估容量，出口匯流也可能讓上游兩條通道互相阻塞。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using structural width instead of clear width overstates capacity; merging exits can make two upstream passages obstruct each other. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.
